# Magnitude and direction

<!-- STEP id="direction" -->
Every force acts in a direction. Friction acts opposite to the motion. The Earth pulls objects towards itself. Water pushes a floating object up.

The strength of a force is its magnitude.

<!-- STEP id="newton" -->
The SI unit of force is the newton. Its symbol is N, and the word is written with a small n.

If the magnitude or the direction of a force changes, its effect changes too.
